name: okf
description: Write, validate, and search OKF bundles. Use OKF 0.3 or preview a migration from 0.2. Includes repository review and Git backfill skills.

interface.shortDescription: Author, validate, consume, and migrate OKF bundles.
interface.longDescription: Use open-knowledge-format to read, validate, and migrate bundles, okf-maintain to review knowledge after code changes, and okf-backfill to draft notes from Git history.
defaultPrompt: Use $open-knowledge-format to validate this OKF bundle.
Use $open-knowledge-format to design an OKF bundle.
Use $open-knowledge-format to preview an OKF 0.2 to 0.3 migration.
Use $okf-maintain to review repository knowledge after this code change.
Use $okf-backfill to reconstruct draft knowledge from this Git history.
